name: Multiple Quantum Measurements
hint: A quantum measurement fixes the state. Repeating a measurement without creating a new superposition or entanglement therefore produces no new state and can distort the intended animation or response.
instruction: Measure again only after starting a new quantum state, or store the first result for subsequent decisions.
